summary: Existing non-equivalence reason still holds against primary sources. GEO deposits only the raw count matrix; the paper (PMC10853283) reports day-14 overfeeding and day-17 (d14+3 recovery, overfeeding already stopped) DESeq2 results separately, excludes one day-14 control, and describes no pooled-day analysis. The registered pooled common effect (12 versus 12, ~day+group) therefore has no contrast- or cohort-compatible author reference, so no author-concordance-v2 comparison is valid and no metrics were computed. Separate day-14 and day-17 tracks remain the route to concordance.

metrics.basis: Not computed: the registered pooled overfeed-versus-control contrast is not compatible with either author day-specific table (contrast and cohort differ).
